PASS WITH CAVEATS (batch_389, 2026-09-24). 8 rows = 4 items x resp {0,1}; validate_items.R --table-sets passes item and resp sets. Built as the direct sibling of peters_2025_si_current (batch_388) and peters_2025_hw_frequency (batch_386). (1) STEP 3b: not a DMQ/RAA table and not a Likert scale. Built by data/peters_2025_covid19_risk_precautions.py (FAMILIES work -> peters_2025_work_precautions) from the LimeSurvey multiple-choice checkbox question 'work' (REQs sheet variable_label 'Work', ls_question_type checkboxes). Content matches the table name and the dictionary Description ('workplace-contact precautions checklist (4 items, binary)'): the four live codes ptnts/chldr/publc/home are exactly the question's four options. Note the question asks about proximity to others at work, not about precautions; the dictionary wording 'precautions' is loose but names the right question, so no mismatch is logged. (2) MAPPING: the script matches raw columns ^work\.([a-zA-Z]+)\.$ and lower-cases the group (all four codes already lower case), a name-preserving rename, no positional step. The REQs sheet keys each option by ls_answer_code (= LimeSurvey subquestion title = raw column infix); 4/4 codes reconstruct and 4/4 texts are identical in the sheet and in the deployed English v1.10 survey file. Recorded paper_explicit rather than data_labels by the sibling convention (companion instrument-definition sheet, not the export header). Step 5b VERIFIED: cell-level re-run over sid 100110's five raw exports reproduces 39480/39480 cells (9870 respondents x 4), 0 one-sided, 0 disagreeing (verify_peters_2025_work_precautions.R, VERDICT: PASS). (3) STRUCTURE: the question stem 'Currently, do you work within a short distance of others?' applies to every item and is recorded once in instructions; section_prompt blank (group workGroup has no description; question help empty). item_text = the checkbox option label, verbatim. Single trivial section_id; correct_response blank. (4) OPTIONS: resp 1 = option ticked (raw 'Y'), resp 0 = not ticked, per the processing script. A checkbox has no printed response labels, so option_text is BLANK for both resp values; the 0/1 meaning is stated in public_note. (5) NON-EXCLUSIVE 'home': the survey defines no exclude_all_others attribute and the question is not mandatory (mandatory=N). 'I am working from home or not working currently' is ticked by 46468 of 75012 respondents, 1430 of whom also ticked at least one 'Yes, with ...' option (logically contradictory for a current snapshot, but the survey permitted it; kept as data, not a mapping issue). (6) LANGUAGE: per the 2026-09-11 multi-language ruling, language lists all 22 cov_language values in the live table by respondent count: en 34858, nl 26287, ro 6163, it 2074, tr 1606, pt-BR 1519, fr 891, es 383, id 305, el 260, pt 220, de 129, zh-Hans 81, hu 53, ar 51, am 42, pl 28, ja 21, zh-Hant-HK 21, ur 13, ko 4, he 3; none missing. Base fields hold the English master text (read by the en respondents, 34858 of 75012, 46.5%); other deployments read translations held in the same production survey files (e.g. Dutch 'Werk je op dit moment in de nabijheid van anderen?'), not shipped, so no _translated columns and text_source=study_materials. (7) RIGHTS: applied the existing YCR allow row, as for si_current/hw_frequency; not re-derived. (8) DATA OBSERVATION (not a defect): every one of the 75012 respondents has all 4 items (300048 rows) because the script gates on the *Est equation column, which LimeSurvey fills for everyone who reached the page; resp 0 therefore cannot distinguish 'not ticked' from 'skipped'. 1375 respondents ticked nothing.
